review_candidates.title: InsightBM Project Delivery (SA)
review_candidates.description: Company Description MSX International is seeking an experienced Business Management Consultant to be embedded full-time within a leading automotive OEM client's offices in South Africa. This is a high-impact, client-facing role that sits at the intersection of business consulting, financial analysis, and dealer development. Working closely with the OEM's Dealer Development team, you will help shape and execute the client's dealer network performance strategy — leveraging the InsightBM platform, financial and operational data, and your automotive retail expertise to coach, consult, and drive measurable improvements across the dealer network. If you are a commercially minded consultant with a strong automotive background, a passion for data-driven decision-making, and the credibility to engage senior dealer and OEM stakeholders, this role offers a unique opportunity to deliver real and lasting impact at a national scale. Job Description Key Responsibilities Dealer Network Performance Management Support the OEM Dealer Development team in the design and execution of the local Business Management strategy. Analyse dealer performance data and KPIs to proactively identify business risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities across the network. Conduct ad hoc business analyses to support OEM decision-making, strategic planning, and performance reviews. Develop practical, data-backed recommendations to improve dealer profitability, operational efficiency, and customer experience performance. InsightBM Platform Support & Engagement Champion the adoption and effective use of the InsightBM business intelligence platform across the dealer network and OEM teams. Support ongoing improvements in data quality, reporting accuracy, and dashboard utilisation within the InsightBM platform. Design and deliver training programmes for OEM personnel and dealer teams on platform functionality and best practices. Monitor and report on dealer engagement levels with the platform, implementing targeted interventions to increase participation and adoption where needed. Coaching & Consulting Deliver structured coaching interventions to help dealer management teams understand, interpret, and act on their business performance data. Educate dealers on core Business Management principles — including financial statement interpretation, KPI management, and operational best practices. Support dealers in translating performance insights into concrete, prioritised operational action plans with clear accountability and timelines. Stakeholder Management Build and maintain trusted, productive relationships with OEM stakeholders, Dealer Development Managers, and dealer principals. Act as a credible business advisor to both OEM teams and dealer leadership, providing objective analysis and strategic guidance. Facilitate effective communication and alignment between the OEM, dealer network, and MSX consulting teams. Project Coordination Coordinate the planning and delivery of advanced consulting projects executed by MSX Performance Improvement Consultants, ensuring alignment with client objectives and timelines. Support the implementation of Performance Groups, dealer development programmes, and other structured improvement initiatives. Track project milestones, outcomes, and follow-up actions; report progress to MSX and OEM leadership. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Management, Commerce, or a closely related discipline. Professional accounting or finance qualification (e.g., CA(SA), CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent). Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in automotive retail, dealer operations, business management, dealership finance, or dealer development. Demonstrable experience working with automotive OEMs and/or dealer networks in South Africa. (Essential) Strong working knowledge of automotive retail business models, dealership financial statements (composite reporting), and dealer performance management frameworks. (Essential) Previous experience in training delivery, performance coaching, or consulting engagements within the automotive sector. (Highly Desirable) Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Technical & Analytical Skills Strong financial analysis capability, including proficiency in reading and interpreting dealer composite financial statements. Ability to analyse multi-dimensional KPI datasets to identify root causes, trends, and business improvement opportunities. Solid understanding of dealership profit drivers across all departments: New & Used Vehicle Sales, Aftersales, Parts, Service, and Customer Experience (CX). Hands-on experience with business intelligence and data reporting platforms. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; Power BI experience preferred. Consulting & Problem-Solving Skills Structured analytical approach to complex business challenges. Ability to translate data and insights into clear, actionable business recommendations tailored to the audience. Proven capability in preparing and presenting executive-level performance reports and business cases. Experience facilitating workshops, training sessions, and performance review meetings. Interpersonal & Leadership Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional South African languages are an advantage. Demonstrated ability to influence and build credibility with dealer principals and senior OEM stakeholders. Strong coaching, facilitation, and active listening skills. Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working autonomously within a client-embedded environment. High degree of professionalism, discretion, and cultural sensitivity when operating within a client organisation. Additional Information Success Measures The Business Management Consultant will be assessed against the following performance indicators: Platform Engagement | Improvement in dealer engagement rates with the InsightBM platform Reporting Quality | Accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of business management reporting Action Plan Adoption | Proportion of dealers implementing recommended operational action plans Stakeholder Satisfaction | OEM and internal MSX stakeholder satisfaction ratings Training Delivery | Completion of planned coaching and training programmes across the network Performance Improvement | Identification and realisation of measurable dealer performance gains Project Delivery | On-time, on-quality delivery of consulting interventions and performance programmes Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a commercially astute automotive professional who combines deep dealership financial knowledge with the consulting skills to translate analysis into action. They have walked the floor of South African dealerships, understand the pressures dealer principals face, and have the gravitas to engage OEM leadership with confidence. They are as comfortable building a financial model in Excel as they are facilitating a performance review with a room full of dealer managers. They bring structure to complexity, turn data into stories, and hold others accountable to improvement plans with professionalism and empathy. Above all, they are passionate about sustainable dealer performance improvement — and have the track record to prove it. MSX is an equal opportunities employer and encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, neurodiversity or other personal characteristics and backgrounds, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, or marital and parental status. As users of the Disability Confident scheme, we interview all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the vacancy.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur Système Commandes de Vol Electriques H/F
review_candidates.description: Cugnaux Publiée Le 8 janvier 2026 Descriptif de l’entreprise AURA AERO, constructeur aéronautique français, conçoit et fabrique des avions à faible émission de carbone présentant une efficacité inégalée. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs, nous mettons à profit les talents pluridisciplinaires de notre équipe pour apporter des réponses aux enjeux des mobilités d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Nous rejoindre, c’est innover avec passion pour contribuer à l'émergence d’avions de nouvelle génération. Rattaché au Responsable de l’équipe “Aircraft Control” du Bureau d’études Expérimental, l’ Ingénieur Système Commandes de Vol Electriques H/F sera chargé des activités liées au développement du système de commandes de vol électriques : spécification, conception, V&V, de l’implémentation des algorithmes du système de commandes de vol (logiques, surveillances, lois de pilotage, etc). À ce titre, vos missions principales sont les suivantes : Contribuer aux activités d’ingénierie système en relation avec le développement du système de commandes de vol et de ses éléments logiques: spécification, validation, traçabilité Contribuer à l’installation et au câblage du système dans l’avion ; Contribuer au développement des algorithmes système : logiques, surveillances, asservissements ; Contribuer à l’intégration des algorithmes de lois de pilotage ; Assurer le suivi fournisseur sous contraintes programme, coûts, qualité ; Contribuer à la rédaction des documents de certification ; Supporter la production, les essais sol et vol. Issu d’une formation supérieure en aéronautique, vous disposez d’ au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine aéronautique en design, idéalement dans le domaine des commandes de vol. Vous aspirez à travailler sur des technologies innovantes et vous aimez travailler en équipe dans un contexte pluridisciplinaire. Vous êtes reconnu pour vos qualités relationnelles, votre curiosité et votre capacité à proposer des solutions et à défendre vos choix techniques. Vous vous appuyez également sur votre proactivité, votre sens de l’organisation, votre rigueur afin de mener à bien vos missions. Enfin, vos atouts pour ce poste sont les suivants : Connaissance des systèmes de commandes de vol électriques ; Connaissance des activités d'ingénierie système Connaissance des moyens de simulation, langage de calcul scientifique. Un niveau d'anglais courant est exigé. Chaque candidature sera traitée de manière égale dans le respect de la diversité et de l'inclusion et sur les seuls critères de la compétence et de la motivation. Les Petits Plus Statut cadre, forfait 211 jours/an ; Primes de 13ème mois & d’intéressement ; Mutuelle et Prévoyance d’entreprise prises en charge à 100% ; Carte Tickets Restaurants Swile à hauteur de 9€ par jour travaillé pris en charge à 50% ; Accès à la plateforme HappyPal & événements CSE ; Culture d'entreprise rythmée par des événements fédérateurs & des moments de convivialité.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur IVVQ système drone MTO
review_candidates.description: Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d’une centaine de disciplines, de l’optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l’intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c’est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C’est donc être au cœur d’une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C’est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d’accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C’est aussi la possibilité d’évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d’activité, voire de pays. Lieu : Elancourt, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Au coeur de Saint Quentin en Yvelines, le site d'Elancourt est un des centres d’excellence technologique Thales les plus importants. La diversité et la technicité des systèmes et équipements mobilisent des savoir-faire dans plus de 80 métiers dans les solutions de défense, de sécurité de haute technologie et de services numériques. Au sein du segment Drone Warfare , rattaché à l'activité Véhicules et Systèmes Tactiques (VTS), vous participez au développement de systèmes de drones militaires destinés aux marchés français et internationaux. Vous intervenez sur le développement du drone Munitions TéléOpérées (MTO) , en contribuant aux activités d'intégration, de vérification, de validation et de qualification du système. Sous la responsabilité du Responsable IVVQ, vous participez à l'ensemble du cycle de validation du système, depuis les essais sur banc jusqu'aux essais en conditions réelles. Dans Ce Cadre, Vous Réalisez les activités d'intégration, de vérification, de validation et de qualification (IVVQ), conformément au plan de tests défini. Contribuez aux essais sur banc, notamment aux tests de non-régression et à la validation des évolutions du système. Participez aux essais terrain, notamment aux essais en vol, ainsi qu'aux démonstrations auprès des clients. Rédigez les rapports d'essais afin de formaliser les résultats des activités de vérification et de validation. Renseignez et suivez les indicateurs de performance (KPI) des activités IVVQ, contribuant au reporting du projet. Votre profil Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences en IVVQ au service du développement de systèmes de drones militaires innovants ? De formation ingénieur ou équivalent Bac+5 , vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative en intégration, vérification, validation et qualification (IVVQ), acquise dans le secteur de la défense et/ou de l'aéronautique. Vous Disposez Notamment De Compétences En Systèmes embarqués, avec une bonne compréhension de leurs caractéristiques techniques. Systèmes soumis à des contraintes temps réel. Gestion de configuration et gestion des faits techniques, dans le cadre des activités d'intégration et de validation. Une expérience dans le domaine des drones ou des systèmes autonomes constitue un atout. Une connaissance du secteur de la défense est également appréciée. Vous disposez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et appréciez le travail au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. Autonomie, esprit d'initiative, créativité et capacité à prendre du recul sur des problématiques techniques sont des qualités que l'on vous reconnaît. Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Le mot de l'équipe « Rejoignez une équipe passionnée sur des produits innovants et dans un contexte de marché porteur ! » Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

review_candidates.title: Head of Middle East
review_candidates.description: About Us The Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA) is the chartered professional body for actuaries. We have over 32,000 members around the world. The Membership Group looks after the full member journey: how we attract members, support them as they progress and keep them with us. The teams you'll support deliver our strategy across the UK, Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Africa. They also run a large programme of events and conferences, and look after our marketing, communications, volunteer engagement and research. The role The Head of Middle East is the IFoA's senior in-market representative in the region, based in Riyadh and reporting to the Director of Market, Partner and Member Development. The role leads the strategic development and commercial growth of IFoA's presence across the Middle East — driving membership, revenue and brand profile while managing relationships with a wide and senior external stakeholder community. The post-holder also holds statutory responsibility as General Manager of IFoA's Foreign Branch Office in KSA. This is a standalone role requiring significant autonomy, entrepreneurial drive and the credibility to operate at the most senior levels across government, regulation, employers and academia. The Successful Candidate Will Need Proven market development and growth experience in the Middle East, particularly Saudi Arabia and UAE The ability to engage and influence at C-suite, government and regulatory level Experience of B2B sales, account management and strategic partnership development A strong, established network in the region Bachelor degree level education minimum (KSA branch office regulatory requirements apply) The ability to work independently and remain self-motivated in an in-market, solo role Experience of working within a membership organisation and with senior volunteers is desirable. What You'll Be Doing Develop and deliver market plans in accordance to objectives and targets set and measured by IFoA. Deliver initiatives that drive sustainable member growth and retention and sell other IFoA products and services. Work collaboratively with the Middle East Strategic Committee, and any other volunteer groups, as required to provide support to local activities and ensure activities are aligned to the overall strategic goals for the region. Identify strategic partnerships that will add value to the IFoA and its membership. Champion the IFoA brand and grow the IFoA's reputation and influence, through raising the profile of IFoA among key stakeholders such as universities, employers, government and local regulators. Understand and advise on the changing regulatory landscapes across the region and how this might impact members, market demands, and the product and service offering from the IFoA. Build strong and mutually beneficial relationships with employer key accounts and contacts, developing positive working relationships with all customer touch points. People/leadership Skills What we're looking for The Head of Middle East must be a highly committed and driven individual who values the input of colleagues and volunteers to work collaboratively. They will quickly earn the trust of external stakeholders, members and colleagues. Essential Experience And Skills Educated to at least Bachelor degree level Strong market awareness and relevant experience throughout the region, especially Saudi Arabia and UAE Proven delivery of growth plans and strategic partnerships Proven ability to effectively engage and influence a variety of audiences at all levels of a business including C-suite. Proficient when liaising with senior regulators and other governmental organisations Focus on relationships, ability to gain trust and deliver results through communication, expectation setting and completion of planned deliverables. Indirect b2b sales and effective account management Demonstrable solid business acumen, sound decision-making, analytical and organisational skills in a fast-paced environment; a consultative approach to managing complex client relationships. Strong networking and established network within the region Ability to work independently and remain motivated. Desirable Experience of initiating and delivering governmental and non-governmental partnerships Experience of working for a membership organisation Experience of working with senior volunteers and committees To apply, send your CV and a short supporting statement/cover letter to our local partner working with us on this role: justin@goasiatalent.com The IFoA encourages applicants from a variety of backgrounds and experience and welcomes diversity with regard not only to protected characteristics but also diversity of thought. Diversity, equity and inclusion are more than just words for us. That’s why we are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels included and respected, and where no one is unfairly discriminated against. Consequently, we promote diversity, equity and inclusion in all our policies, practices and procedures, and actively encourage applications from a diverse range of potential candidates. All applications for our roles are considered on merit alone, and if you don’t meet all the criteria but believe you have something to offer, we want to hear from you. For more information on our commitments, please see our DEI strategy page. Read more on working for the IFoA: https://actuaries.org.uk/ifoa-jobs

review_candidates.title: Head of Global Visual Merchandising
review_candidates.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE HOW GANNI COMES TO LIFE ACROSS EVERY PHYSICAL CUSTOMER TOUCHPOINT? WE ARE LOOKING FOR A COMMERCIAL, CREATIVE, AND HANDS-ON LEADER TO DRIVE OUR GLOBAL VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY. Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You As Head of Global Visual Merchandising, you will play a key role in bringing the GANNI brand to life across our global retail network. Acting as the bridge between Creative and Commercial, you will translate seasonal creative direction into visual merchandising concepts that strengthen the customer experience, support commercial performance, and ensure a consistent brand representation across all physical customer touchpoints. Working closely with Creative, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Marketing, and Product teams, you will develop global visual merchandising standards while supporting markets in delivering best-in-class execution. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution - project management, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities ahead of you: Global Visual Merchandising Strategy Develop and continuously evolve GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy across all physical customer touchpoints. Translate seasonal creative direction into commercially effective visual merchandising concepts and execution. Act as the bridge between Creative and Commercial to ensure visual merchandising aligns with both brand identity and commercial priorities. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution across the business. Brand Representation & Customer Experience Develop global VM guidelines, seasonal playbooks, execution decks, and visual standards. Ensure consistent brand representation across Retail stores, Wholesale, Department Stores, Concessions, Showrooms, Pop-ups, and Events. Lead the visual merchandising direction for seasonal launches, campaigns, collaborations, and key commercial moments. Ensure VM standards are executed consistently across all markets while allowing relevant local adaptations. Create engaging customer experiences that support both the brand and commercial objectives. Commercial Performance Partner closely with Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, and Marketing to maximise commercial performance through visual merchandising. Use retail KPIs and commercial insights to continuously improve customer experience and sales performance. Support product sell-through through effective product presentation, storytelling, customer flow, and merchandising principles. Monitor store feedback and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Global VM Community & Capability Support and develop GANNI's global network of field Visual Merchandising resources and Retail VM Ambassadors. Develop training programmes, tools, and best practices that strengthen VM capabilities across markets. Coach regional VM resources and retail teams to ensure consistent execution. Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the global VM community. Showrooms & Physical Brand Experience Lead the visual merchandising strategy across global showrooms during seasonal sell-in periods. Ensure collections are presented in a commercially effective, inspiring, and customer-focused way. Cross-Functional Projects Lead global VM projects from concept through implementation. Support new store openings, refurbishments, showroom projects, retail concepts, and pop-up activations. Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, Product Development, and Retail Operations. Continuously identify opportunities to simplify VM processes and improve ways of working across markets. Must Have Requirements 5–8 years of experience within Visual Merchandising in fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail. Experience developing and implementing visual merchandising strategies across multiple markets and sales channels. Strong understanding of how visual merchandising influences customer behaviour, supports commercial performance, and creates a consistent customer experience. Experience creating global VM guidelines, seasonal toolkits, showroom concepts, and visual standards. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across Creative and Commercial functions. Excellent project management and organisational skills. Strong communication and presentation skills. Fluent in English. Willingness to travel internationally. THE GANNI WAY We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial understanding and enjoys working across functions to bring ideas to life. You are a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys turning creative concepts into clear, practical solutions. You build strong relationships, communicate with confidence, and naturally collaborate across teams and markets. You have a curious mindset, continuously look for opportunities to improve, and understand how strong visual merchandising can strengthen both the customer experience and business performance. We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect) , Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!) , Authenticity (you march at your own beat!) , Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences). The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system! GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing VM team! WHAT ELSE? Based in Copenhagen. Global role with regular international travel. Opportunity to shape the future of GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy and execution across Retail, Wholesale, Showrooms, and other physical customer touchpoints. Lead and develop a global VM team while working closely with colleagues across Creative and Commercial functions. DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression. We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us. To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role. BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY! We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community. We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “ Apply for position ” button. MORE GANNI GOODIES You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. review_candidates.description: Who We Are MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry. We’re scaling fast and looking for superstars who are excited to redefine a legacy industry and build something big. As a Founding Recruiter you will own and support end‑to‑end hiring for MAVI’s internal teams, spanning both technical and non‑technical roles. You’ll work closely with the founders and leadership team as a trusted partner, helping design hiring strategies, build scalable processes, and attract exceptional talent globally. This is a high‑impact role for someone who thrives in fast‑moving environments and wants real ownership in shaping how a company grows. What You’ll Do: Lead end‑to‑end recruitment for MAVI’s internal roles across tech and non‑tech functions. Partner closely with founders and hiring managers to understand role requirements, hiring priorities, and team needs. Design and execute sourcing strategies across regions (with a strong focus on LATAM, and exposure to APAC and other global markets). Build and nurture proprietary talent pipelines and networks using creative and non‑traditional sourcing approaches. Screen, vet, and interview candidates, acting as a quality gatekeeper aligned with MAVI’s hiring bar. Define, track, and improve recruitment KPIs (time‑to‑hire, funnel conversion, quality of hire, etc.). Collaborate with founders, TA teammates, and engineering to introduce automation and process efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and hiring workflows. Continuously refine hiring processes and talent strategies to support rapid, sustainable scaling. Serve as a thought partner to founders on talent strategy, market insights, and hiring best practices. What We’re Looking For: 2-5 years of end‑to‑end recruiting experience. Proven ability to hire both technical and non‑technical roles in fast‑paced environments. Strong sourcing expertise using active and passive techniques across multiple geographies (LATAM and APAC experience is a strong plus). Experience vetting candidates through structured interviews and assessments. Comfort experimenting with and optimizing multiple sourcing channels. Data‑driven mindset with experience defining and tracking recruitment metrics and KPIs. Familiarity with recruiting tools such as LinkedIn, ATS platforms, and job boards. Prior experience hiring finance or accounting talent is a plus, but not required. Excellent communication, organization, and problem‑solving skills. Builder mindset: adaptable, proactive, humble, and motivated to deliver high‑quality outcomes. Why You Should Join Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration. Equal Opportunity Statement At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience.
